edges.description: Uses MAG through its protocol surface
Serves the same MCP semantics over HTTP
Dispatches setup, configuration, and uninstall commands
Starts and hosts the MCP stdio server
Constructs embedding and optional LLM backends
Exposes domain operations as validated tools
Delegates tool execution to SQLite storage
Implements model traits used by memory operations
Scores and returns domain search results
Defines backend access around domain contracts
